lines.line: Hello, you seem new around here, I'll help you get started
Many restless souls lie here and will soon rise from their grave
Once they do, you better be ready!
The fry cook before you used to burgers to defend themselves.
They even installed launchers in the counter to send off the burgers.
Just wait til a zombie appears ahead of the counter and press the bell.
As for the burger assembling, it's easy.
Cook the burgers behind on the grill, don't let the burgers burn though.
Combine the patties with other ingredients on the prep table and then move them to the counter for attack!
